title: Evidence-Bound Course Packages

ciFast.note: Remote exact-commit verification begins after push.

ciDeep.note: No paid-provider, instructor-panel, accessibility-certification, or classroom result is claimed.

deploy.note: Production verification is downstream of the pushed commit.

liveProvider.note: The retained release packages are current-compiler replays of saved model-authored maps and graphs, not fresh model generations.

claims.summary: Instructional-plan, evidence, intent, assessment-lineage, and saved-project migration gates precede complete material drafting.
Evidence and lesson-intent bindings survive compilation into every supported material family and package surface.
The package boundary skips empty lesson slices and renders dense working-document tails with compact readable guidance.
Three differently scoped saved-project replays pass independently while the release contract explicitly limits the evidence class and validation claim.

boundaries: The three retained packages are current-compiler replays of saved model-authored course maps and graphs; they are not fresh production model generations.
Deterministic conformance is not a semantic teaching-quality score and does not prove factual accuracy, accessibility, teachability, instructor approval, or classroom effectiveness.
Remote CI and deployment are not claimed before push.
